title: Mia and Max
text:
Mia has a small dog. His name is Max. Max is brown and very friendly. Mia takes Max for a walk every morning.

Max needs food and water every day. Mia also gives him a bath once a week. Max loves his toys, and he likes to play in the park.

questions.text: What is the name of Mia's dog?
How often does Mia give Max a bath?
Why does Mia take Max for a walk every morning?
options: Mia has no time for other things

questions.text: How does Max probably feel about the park?

paragraph_translations: Mia'nın küçük bir köpeği var. Onun adı Max. Max kahverengi ve çok arkadaş canlısı. Mia her sabah Max'i yürüyüşe çıkarır.
Max her gün yiyecek ve suya ihtiyaç duyar. Mia ona ayrıca haftada bir kez banyo yaptırır. Max oyuncaklarını çok sever ve parkta oynamayı sever.
